chunks: From him, from Fudaylah, from Aban, from Abu Maryam al-Ansari, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
In the book of Ali (peace be upon him): 'I do not refrain from food that a cat has eaten from, nor from a drink that a cat has drunk from.'
ai.seo_question: IsQuestionA natural question this verse answers
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) cites a saying of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) to establish the permissibility of consuming food and drink touched by cats. It clarifies that the mere contact of a cat with sustenance does not render it impure (najis) or forbidden, reflecting the Shia juristic view that cats are clean creatures whose saliva does not invalidate consumption.
